title: migrate: rows bound to a read-only base package stored before the #28905 close are invisible to `os migrate packageless-overlays`, so their only exit drops the customization
body:
domain:server#5 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQKwKFCp1m6Pb6Q8c1

Source: the contract review of PR #29270 (#28905), record 6577747588, should-fix S2.

Rows that a save naming a read-only code package stored before #28905's close are still served in place of the base's document. The `os migrate packageless-overlays` census reads package-less rows only, so it never lists them. Today their only exit is a delete (left open on purpose), and a delete drops the customization instead of moving it into the base's `.custom` pair, declared.

Ask: the ceremony also finds rows bound to a read-only base on the five overlay types, and moves each into the pair with its `overrides` declaration, using the same moved / added-member outcomes #28904 introduced (`protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts`). A dry run lists them, and `--apply` moves them. Pins on both topologies.

Files: `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packageless-overlay-migration.ts` (the #28904 file) and the cli ceremony's census reader, if it filters.
